# Phase Three — Thirty Further Refinements

1. Verify product-memory codec rejects arbitrary non-product routes.
2. Verify URI-decoding failures cannot crash page boot.
3. Verify duplicate recents collapse deterministically.
4. Verify favorites cannot duplicate routes.
5. Verify removing favorite persists immediately.
6. Verify recent rank uses canonical absolute URL resolution for relative catalog links.
7. Verify memory decoration is idempotent.
8. Verify badge rerender removes stale badges before adding current state.
9. Verify favorite control mounts exactly once.
10. Verify favorite control uses the current canonical product path.
11. Verify product visits record before commerce interaction is required.
12. Verify catalog pages themselves are not recorded as products.
13. Verify global foundation remains below the source ceiling after integration.
14. Split foundation integration if it would exceed the ceiling.
15. Verify Apps runtime remains below the ceiling after integration.
16. Split Apps integration into a sibling adapter if needed.
17. Verify Games projection remains below the ceiling after integration.
18. Split Games integration into a sibling adapter if needed.
19. Verify browser-local retention does not depend on authentication.
20. Verify logout/login cannot corrupt local route memory.
21. Verify startup timing reports database stage distinctly from auth.
22. Verify temporary DB startup never points at production storage.
23. Verify reconciliation exposes counts/statuses without leaking account content.
24. Verify workflow handoff carries explicit typed route/value metadata, not opaque blobs.
25. Verify handoffs degrade gracefully when target app is unavailable.
26. Verify accessibility focus order after commerce footer gains favorite control.
27. Verify mobile sheet has no horizontal overflow.
28. Verify performance cost of retention is negligible and synchronous storage is tiny.
29. Re-run generated catalog/sitemap freshness after shared changes even if not directly touched.
30. End with a full touched-file readback and only evidence-backed completion claims.
